A dead coral is the dead variant of coral. There are five variants total: tube, brain, bubble, fire, and horn.
cobblestone slab
A cobblestone slab is a decorative slab variant of cobblestone that generates in overworld structures and is used for building.
please what is the recipe for oak planks

Planks are used in many different crafting recipes. Stairs, slabs, fences, fence gates, doors, trapdoors, pressure plates, buttons, signs, and boats must be crafted from planks of the same type, and the crafted result depends on the type used.
what is field masoned banner pattern in minecraft
A field masoned banner pattern is a banner pattern used to customize banners with a shape of bricks.
what is ender chest
In Minecraft, an ender chest is a type of chest whose contents are exclusive to each player, and they can be placed and accessed from anywhere in any dimension.
and how can i get it
In Minecraft, ender chests naturally generate alongside a chest in certain End city treasure rooms.
and what do i use it for

Like a normal chest, if a solid block is placed above an ender chest, it cannot be opened. Ender chests can be opened by pressing the use control. Ender chests can be used like normal chests, except all ender chests in the world are interconnected, including in different dimensions.
how to obtain target in minecraft
